function.name: read_file
function.description: Read the contents of a file. Returns numbered lines. Use offset and limit to paginate through large files.

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed, default 1)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read (default 2000)

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file at the given path. Creates parent directories if needed.

path.description: The file path to write to

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Edit a file by replacing old_text with new_text. Supports minor whitespace/line-ending differences. Set replace_all=true to replace every occurrence. Use the shortest unique old_text fragment that anchors the edit. Do not copy the full existing file to append content. To insert a YAML list item before a Markdown closing fence, old_text can be exactly "\n```\n" and new_text contains only the new item followed by that fence. Keep all previous file contents outside the chosen fragment unchanged.

old_text.description: The text to find and replace

function.name: list_dir
function.description: List the contents of a directory. Set recursive=true to explore nested structure. Common noise directories (.git, node_modules, __pycache__, etc.) are auto-ignored.

function.name: verify_session
function.description: Verify a runtime session waiting for semantic validation, or review an already verified session when its RGB evidence is still available.

function.name: append_yaml_item
function.description: Append one object to an existing top-level list in a Markdown YAML document. Supply only the NEW item; the tool preserves all existing records and other document content. It does not generate items, interpret tasks or alter existing records. Duplicate session_id values in SESSIONS.md are rejected; edit the existing draft instead. For readability, place a scalar-valued property last in item, after its nested mappings. JSON key order does not affect values. Return complete JSON: close every nested object, the item, arguments, and the outer call. Generic syntax example (not a task template): {"name":"append_yaml_item","arguments":{"path":"notes.md","list_key":"entries","item":{"details":{"value":1},"label":"new"}}}

function.name: patch_yaml_item
function.description: Update selected fields in exactly one existing object of a Markdown YAML list, matched by an identity key and value. Nested mappings merge recursively; scalar/list values replace. No creation, no identity change, no task interpretation. For an existing Session draft use path=SESSIONS.md, list_key=sessions, match_key=session_id, match_value=its ID, and patch containing only the fields you intend to correct, such as benchmark, execution or timeouts. Other records and unrelated fields are preserved. This does not dispatch or approve a Session.

function.name: read_files
function.description: Read 1 to 8 independent current workspace text files in one call. Each item contains a fresh native read_file result or, when enabled and the complete identical text is still in this conversation, a reference to that earlier tool result. This tool only reads; it never changes files, queues tasks or uses cached results. Use read_file with pagination if any returned file is truncated.
